source_frozen_evaluation.scope: Policy/archive and unchanged optimizer-clock evidence from frozen source-validation/target acting records; not deserialized actor-parameter comparison

semantics.episodes: Indices1/2/4/8 are sequential task episodes. They do not automatically mean separate support/query trials.
semantics.frozen: Fixed source actor with stochastic sampling across8 episodes, no target updates
semantics.online: Fresh independent source restore per task/stage; fresh target replay, replacement from1row, no new warmup; updates occur after every chunk including inside episode1

verification_scope: Read-only JSON, checkpoint file SHA and ZIP CRC only. No tensor/pickle/array/model loading, tests, simulators, allocation, process/resource control, input mutations or full event forest scan.
